condition: recombinant cargo-free WT shell expressed in E. coli
notes: Recombinant cargo-free WT Empty-Enc formed homogeneous regular nanocompartments with an average diameter of approximately 21 nm, indistinguishable in overall size from the EncFtn-loaded particles. No separate high-resolution cryo-EM/PDB structure was reported for the empty sample. The T=1, 60-subunit icosahedral assignment is inherited from the structurally resolved WT Loaded-Enc shell and the matching shell morphology; it was not independently established by subunit counting in the Empty-Enc TEM sample.
